items.heading: Kokoda
details: Key ingredients: fish, coconut milk, lime juice, tomato, chili
Cure raw fish chunks in fresh lime juice until opaque.
Drain excess liquid and mix in coconut milk.
Add diced tomato, onion and chili.
Chill briefly and serve cold as a refreshing starter.

items.heading: Lovo Chicken
details: Key ingredients: chicken, coconut cream, taro leaves, banana leaf
Marinate chicken pieces in coconut cream and seasoning.
Wrap the chicken in taro and banana leaves.
Cook in an underground earth oven (lovo) over hot stones for hours.
Unwrap and serve the smoky, tender chicken.
